title: GitPrepare
description: Clone the shared repo and/or add the worktree (architecture.md 8.1). Idempotent. With sync, an existing worktree is brought up to date before a task starts (shared-members.md 4.2).

base.description: Branch to create from when branch does not exist yet.

sync.description: Bring an existing worktree up to date (daemon feature git.sync). member: fetch, then switch to the member branch if needed, fast-forward it to origin/<ref> when it has no commits outside it and the tree is clean, else merge origin/<ref> into it (abort on conflict). review: fetch and check out origin/<ref> detached (read-only review of another member's branch).

ref.description: Remote branch name without origin/: the thread branch (member) or the branch under review (review).

deadline.description: Skip the sync (action expired) when the job starts after this time: the console has already sent the task brief and the member may be working in the tree.
